acquisition method: The data acquisition mode used a data-dependent scanning program that alternated between one MS scan followed by 20 MS/MS scans
alkylation reagent: then alkylated with 11 mM iodoacetamide for 15 min at room temperature in darkness.
alkylation concentration: then alkylated with 11 mM iodoacetamide for 15 min at room temperature in darkness.
cleavage agent: Trypsin was added at a mass ratio of 1:50 (trypsin: protein)
enrichment method: antibody beads (Lot number PTM503, PTM Bio)
the supernatant was gently shaken and incubated with pre-washed antibody beads (Lot number PTM503, PTM Bio) at 4°C overnight.
instrument: followed by tandem mass spectrometry (MS/MS) in Q ExactiveTM Plus (Thermo) coupled online to the UPLC.

precursor tolerance: The precursor ions mass error tolerance was 20 ppm for the first search and 5 ppm for the main search
